D5/S3/QuantumBounds/LagrangeGramIdentity.name: D5.S3.QuantumBounds.LagrangeGramIdentity.lagrange_gram_identity
D5/S3/QuantumBounds/LagrangeGramIdentity.signature: theorem lagrange_gram_identity {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (u v : ι → ℝ) : (∑ i ∈ s, u i ^ 2) * (∑ i ∈ s, v i ^ 2) - (∑ i ∈ s, u i * v i) ^ 2 = (∑ i ∈ s, ∑ j ∈ s, (u i * v j - u j * v i) ^ 2) / 2
